BEGIN;
LOCK TABLE hybrid_consequence_work,hybrid_consequence_input,hybrid_consequence_receipt IN ACCESS EXCLUSIVE MODE;
DO $$ BEGIN
 IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hybrid_consequence_work) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hybrid_consequence_input) OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hybrid_consequence_receipt) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'refusing rollback: durable hybrid consequence work, inputs and receipts must be preserved';
 END IF;
END $$;
DROP TRIGGER hybrid_evaluation_job_truncate_immutable ON hybrid_evaluation_job;
DROP TRIGGER hybrid_planning_state_inbox_truncate_immutable ON hybrid_planning_state_inbox;
DROP TABLE hybrid_consequence_receipt;
DROP TABLE hybrid_consequence_input;
DROP TABLE hybrid_consequence_work;
DROP FUNCTION protect_hybrid_consequence_immutable();
COMMIT;
